description: Generate a complete set of SEO and social meta tags for any page. Fill in your details, preview the result, and copy the ready-to-paste HTML block.

faqs.a: Meta tags are HTML elements in a page's <head> that describe the page to search engines and social networks — title, description, preview image and more.
Paste the generated block inside the <head> section of your HTML page, before the closing </head> tag.
faqs.q: Where do I paste this code?

faqs.a: A good title and description improve how your page looks in search results and can raise click-through rates, but they are only one part of SEO.
faqs.q: Do meta tags improve my ranking?
